newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen softer at the open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen softer at the open.

text.p: * Toronto stocks were expected to open lower in quiet trade on Friday. * Traders said U.S. gross domestic product numbers were in line with expectations. * Golds were seen rising on higher prices.
Toronto stocks were expected to open lower on Friday on the coattails of weaker overseas markets.
"It's going south, would be my guess, on the basis of if you look around the world, Europe is very much weaker this morning," one trader said.
He said the gold sector may see some improvement as gold prices have strengthened.
The Toronto Stock Exchange's key 300 Composite Index lost 18.70 points on Friday to reach 6370.33, finishing lower for the third day in a row.
